rules: Run each gate against current saved clean source HEAD with source/resolution/tool snapshots.
Save each completed gate immediately, including failures, and use fresh HEAD for the next gate.
No dependency resolution, source edits, commits or ref alignment while a gate runs.
Generate actual Office outputs in engine cohort before scripted oracle; retain produced artifacts.
Separate font-backed navigation preview review from ordinary test acceptance.
Keep original failure and predecessor evidence unchanged.
Do not wait for or restart Actions; checkpoints use [skip ci].
